purpose: Identify the exact statutory provision, statutory instrument rule, commencement provision and relevant case-law proposition needed to support a classified property-law issue.

verified_examples.proposition: The statutory registration framework governs when a transfer of registered land takes effect on registration.

verified_examples.issue: pre-registration dealing by person entitled to be registered
verified_examples.proposition: The Act contains a specific framework for certain dealings before the person entitled becomes registered.
Inspection of filed documents is subject to specified entitlement and access conditions.
The Rules provide routes for official searches of names, specified property and register/map entries.

case_law_rules: Use a judgment for the proposition actually decided or clearly reasoned, not merely because the case concerns the same subject.
Record court, date, citation, issue and proposition.
Distinguish binding authority from persuasive material where relevant.
Do not convert a party submission into a judicial finding.
hard_stops: No definitive legal proposition without an identified authoritative provision or properly supported case-law proposition.
No historical provision selection from current text alone where amendments or commencement may matter.
No case-law proposition without identifying the relevant passage/issue.
If exact provision resolution fails, return LEGAL_PROVISION_UNRESOLVED.
